answer: Follow the money, not the faces. Every bond must come from a traceable funding source; the registry groups identities sharing one wallet or cluster per epoch window. Groups over five are frozen: no earnings until each member proves independent funding. An honest agent free to wander leaves a normal trail, but a farm cannot hide: ten thousand bonds from a few wallets collapse into one cluster. Splitting across 10,000 independent on-ramps costs about $25 each, $250,000 in all, the nadir of any scheme posing as a crowd. One wallet, one voice; a crowd sharing one purse stands on a ledge.
